title: Privacy Policy
subtitle: At Dr. Anubhuti Dental Studio, protecting your privacy and personal health data is central to our commitment to patient-first care.

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
content: At Dr. Anubhuti Dental Studio, we collect personal information necessary to deliver seamless dental care and appointment management services. This includes details provided during appointment requests, contact form submissions, or patient registration.
The information collected may include your full name, email address, contact phone number, postal address, preferred treatment dates, and relevant clinical history.
We also automatically gather non-personal analytics data such as browser type, IP address, and page interaction patterns to improve website performance and user experience.

sections.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
content: Your information is used exclusively to facilitate your appointments, customize dental treatment plans, process billing transactions, and communicate essential clinical reminders regarding your care.
We may use your contact details to send appointment confirmations, treatment follow-ups, and dental care guidelines via SMS, WhatsApp, or email.
We do not sell, rent, or lease your personal data to any third-party marketing entities under any circumstances.

sections.title: 3. Data Security & Clinical Privacy
content: Dr. Anubhuti Dental Studio implements strict administrative, technical, and physical security measures to safeguard your personal health data against unauthorized access, loss, or disclosure.
Online communications and appointment data transfers are encrypted using Secure Socket Layer (SSL) protocols.
Access to patient records is strictly restricted to authorized clinic staff on a need-to-know basis.

sections.title: 4. Cookies & Web Tracking
content: Our website utilizes essential session cookies and performance tracking scripts to enhance navigation, retain user preferences, and analyze site traffic.
You can choose to disable non-essential cookies through your browser settings; however, certain interactive features of our website may have reduced functionality.

sections.title: 5. Your Rights & Contact Details
content: You have the right to request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal contact data stored with Dr. Anubhuti Dental Studio.
